short: A controversial Greek philosopher and one of the founders of Cynic philosophy.
full:
Diogenes of Sinope was a Greek philosopher and one of the founders of Cynic philosophy. Exiled from his native city for debasing its currency, he moved to Athens and made a virtue of extreme poverty. He believed that virtue was better revealed in action than in theory, and he used his simple lifestyle and behaviour to criticize the social values and institutions of what he saw as a corrupt, confused society.

Famously living in a large ceramic jar in the marketplace, Diogenes challenged convention at every turn, famously carrying a lamp during the day to claim he was looking for an honest man. He rejected the artificiality of civilization and argued for a life lived in accordance with nature. Despite his abrasive manner, his philosophical stance commanded respect, and his radical asceticism and cosmopolitanism influenced the later development of Stoicism.
